goal: Markerless multiview human whole-body imitation, size-retargeted to G1 EDU; improve perception then assess dynamically trackable references

enabled: Current independent cross-view person candidate selection
Deferred detail inference after person choice
World-origin invariant accumulated scaled pelvis displacement
decisions.reason: Perception improves selected real holdout measures; smoother references did not consistently improve full-body dynamics. Coordinate invariance is a correctness fix, not a claim of improved balance.

evaluation_scope.reference: MPI-INF-3DHP markerless multiview reference, not independent Vicon; 12 body points, no measured foot-contact/full-orientation truth
evaluation_scope.robot: Pinned generic G1 29-DOF simulation; actual EDU joint configuration not confirmed

selection_freeze.parameters: >=4 anchors including shoulders and hip/knee pairs; median<=20 px, p80<=35 px, candidate margin>=15 px; current unique views only
selection_freeze.selection: Candidate selected before held-out scoring after short/long development checks; enable only if held-out coverage/success do not decline and large errors do not increase.

post_freeze_changes: No selector threshold changes; integration timing accounting
Defer RTMW details until body candidate chosen, preserve float32 boxes
selection_limitation: Current unique views can still agree on a wrong identity. Heuristic pixel gates are not calibrated probabilities. Rendered mean increases by 0.0118 mm and all-target success loses one target.

strict_result.scope: Selected development packets only; decode/exposure excluded; not a capture latency or full throughput benchmark

streaming_integration.limitations: 15 selected development packets; sequential runs not statistical throughput benchmark. P95 still exceeds 150 ms. Decode, geometry and physical capture latency excluded.
streaming_integration.correction: First deferred completion converted detector float32 boxes to Python lists, changing crop arithmetic and scores. Restoring float32 removed differences. Final strict check uses score tolerance 1e-6 and observed zero difference.

root_path_fix.method: Integrate each accepted pelvis displacement times current target/source ratio. Initial XY is zero; source axes preserved; target base height separate.
root_path_fix.physics_result: All seven paired cases fail whole-body acceptance; several path errors decrease but balance regresses in some scenes. Both methods scored against common corrected source path.

result.error: Trajectory leaves model position limits; independent stop required

trajectory_configuration.limits_note: Simulation reference limits, not certified motor or balance limits. Joint position bounds are loaded from the pinned target model. Root derivative units follow reference_layout; they are not all angular quantities.

result.behavior: Simulation aborted; no motor or network command sent

strategy_audit.finding: No input-layout mismatch found. Model motor effort bounds are additionally enforced; dynamic feasibility and distribution mismatch remain unresolved.

vision_unittest.skip_reason: MuJoCo and Ruckig only installed in robot environment

verification.cuda_note: Startup emitted cuDNN frontend diagnostic; provider checks and actual GPU inference/parity completed successfully. No silent CPU fallback accepted.

dependency_change.rationale: Pinned CPython 3.11 Windows wheel; visual CUDA/OptiX environment unchanged

cleanup.retained: Source videos/caches, baseline and representative constrained logs, compact negative reports, latest corrected references, environments/models

pending_prior_denial.reason: Automatic approval review rejected cleanup: blocked by policy

unresolved: Contact-consistent retargeting and reliable support-state observation
Pelvis/foot full orientation observability and real-domain uncertainty calibration
Whole-body policy adaptation to estimated motion and missing data
Independent motion/force truth and actual G1 hardware validation
